sentences.en: At the same time, although he attended the Paris conference of 1856, he purposely abstained from affixing his signature to the treaty of peace after that of Count Orlov, Russia's chief representative.

sentences.en: He was forced to acquiesce in the first partition of Poland, and when Russia came off third best, Gregory Orlov declared in the council that the minister who had signed such a partition treaty was worthy of death.

sentences.en: They were hampered, moreover, by an insurrection in the Morea, where a Russian expedition under Orlov had stirred up the' Mainotes, and by risings in Syria and Egypt.

sentences.en: But Orlov, perplexed by conflicting instructions and caught in an unfavourable situation by a brigade of the 12th division which was executing the proposed " pursuit," gave way - part of his force in actual rout - and the cavalry that was with him was driven back by the Kobi (reserve army) brigade of the Guard.
sentences.vi: Nhưng Orlov, bối rối trước những chỉ dẫn mâu thuẫn và rơi vào tình huống bất lợi bởi một lữ đoàn thuộc sư đoàn 12 đang thực hiện ""cuộc truy đuổi"" được đề xuất, đã nhường đường - một phần lực lượng của anh ta trong hành trình thực tế - và kỵ binh đi cùng anh ta đã bị đánh lui bởi lữ đoàn Kobi (quân dự bị) của Vệ binh.

sentences.en: The fugitives of Orlov's command disordered the on-coming corps of Stakelberg, and the outer flank of the great counterstroke that was to have rolled up Kuroki's thin line came to an entire standstill.
sentences.vi: Những kẻ chạy trốn dưới quyền chỉ huy của Orlov đã làm xáo trộn quân đoàn sắp tới của Stakelberg, và cánh bên ngoài của cuộc phản công vĩ đại vốn đã cuộn lên phòng tuyến mỏng manh của Kuroki đã hoàn toàn bế tắc.

sentences.en: This was to the effect that Orlov was routed, Stakelberg's command much shaken, and at the same time Zarubayev in Liao-Yang, upon whom Oku and Nozu had pressed a last furious attack, reported that he had only a handful of troops still in reserve.
sentences.vi: Điều này dẫn đến hậu quả là Orlov đã bị đánh bay, lệnh của Stakelberg bị lung lay nhiều, và cùng lúc đó Zarubayev ở Liao-Yang, người mà Oku và Nozu đã thực hiện một cuộc tấn công dữ dội cuối cùng, báo cáo rằng ông ta chỉ còn một số quân dự bị. .

sentences.en: The Orlovs had even stronger motives than Catherine for suppressing the ex-emperor, for Gregory Orlov aspired to win the hand as well as the heart of his imperial mistress, and so long as Catherine's lawful husband lived, even in a prison, such a union would be impossible.

sentences.en: The available evidence points to the irresistible conclusion that on the afternoon of the 18th of July 1762, Peter III., with his consort's connivance, was brutally murdered at Ropsha by Alexius Orlov, Theodore Baryatinski, and several other persons still unknown.
